_about: Public-domain Henry Sloane Coffin (1877-1954), Presbyterian minister of Madison Avenue Church, New York, and later president of Union Theological Seminary, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930: The Creed of Jesus (1907), Social Aspects of the Cross (1911), University Sermons (1914), The Ten Commandments (1915), Some Christian Convictions (1915), In a Day of Social Rebuilding (1918), A More Christian Industrial Order (1920), What is There in Religion? (1922), What to Preach (1926) and The Portraits of Jesus Christ in the New Testament (1926). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 78 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

coffin-creed-of-jesus: The creed of Jesus and other sermons (New York, C. Scribner's sons, 1907)
coffin-social-aspects-cross: Social aspects of the cross (New York : Hodder & Stoughton, 1911)
coffin-university-sermons: University sermons (New Haven : Yale University press, 1914)
coffin-ten-commandments: The Ten Commandments : with a Christian application to present conditions (New York : Hodder & Stoughton ; George H. Doran Co., 1915)
coffin-christian-convictions: Some Christian convictions : a practical restatement in terms of present-day thinking (New Haven : Yale University Press ; London : Oxford University Press, 1915)
coffin-social-rebuilding: In a day of social rebuilding; lectures on the ministry of the church (New Haven, Yale University Press [etc.], 1918)
coffin-industrial-order: A more Christian industrial order (New York, The Macmillan company, 1920)
coffin-what-in-religion: What is there in religion? (New York, The Macmillan Company, 1922)
coffin-what-to-preach: What to preach (New York ; London : Harper & Brothers, 1926)
coffin-portraits-of-jesus: The portraits of Jesus Christ in the New Testament (New York : The Macmillan company, 1926)

_excluded.coffin-other: Hymns of the Kingdom of God, a hymnal he co-edited; everything printed 1930 or later
